CornerPoint.description: A corner: [x, y] or {x, y} in mm, or [x, y] where a coordinate is an expression over the design's parameters, such as ["w / 2", 5]: the corner is then fixed and follows the parameters; text naming no parameter, such as "5", is just that number, in the design's length unit (a JSON number is mm), and does not itself fix the corner. Not a point's id or a snap.

LengthExpr.description: A length: a number in the design's length unit, or an expression such as "w / 2" or "30 mm".

Point2.description: A sketch point in mm: [x, y] or {"x", "y"}.

SketchTarget.description: The sketch: its feature id or its name (default: the one being edited).

input.description: Draw an axis-aligned rectangle from two opposite corners.

connect.description:
Make a new point that lands exactly on an existing point (the origin too) coincident with
it. Default: true.

construction.description: Draw construction geometry, which is not part of a profile. Default: false.

p0.description: One corner. A coordinate typed as an expression holds the corner where the parameters put it.

p1.description: The opposite corner. It must differ from `p0` in both x and y.

sketch.description: The sketch to draw in: its feature id or name. Default: the one being edited.

input.title: RectTwoPointParams

label: 2-Point Rectangle

Created.description: What a command added to its sketch: the ids that the sketch has now and did not before.

constraints.description: Constraint ids, dimensions not among them.

wires.description: The ids of 3D curves, when the command made any.

RectCorners.description: An axis-aligned rectangle's corners by place, as point ids.

bottom_left.description: The corner with the least x and y.

bottom_right.description: The corner with the greatest x and least y.

top_left.description: The corner with the least x and greatest y.

top_right.description: The corner with the greatest x and y.

RectSides.description: An axis-aligned rectangle's sides by place, as line ids.

constraints.description:
The ids of the constraints added: horizontal and vertical sides, a coincident for a corner
that landed on an existing point, the centre rectangle's midpoint.

created.description: Everything the call added to the sketch: `{points, curves, constraints, dimensions}`.

curves.description: The ids of the four sides, counter-clockwise from the bottom side.

param_warnings.description: In the warn parameter-check mode: what the call's parameters got wrong.

sides.description: The sides by place, so a caller can dimension them without inspecting the sketch.

params: p0, p1: opposite corners [x,y] (a coordinate may be an expression over the design's parameters: the corner is fixed and follows them; text naming no parameter, such as "5", is just that number, in the design's length unit (a JSON number is mm), and does not itself fix the corner); construction?. Returns sides {bottom, right, top, left} (line ids) and corners {bottom_left, bottom_right, top_right, top_left} (point ids); connect?: bool (default true: a new point landing exactly on an existing point, the origin too, is made coincident with it). Returns created: {points, curves, constraints, dimensions}: the ids of what it added (stable and never reused: usable right away in sketch.dimension, sketch.constraint.*, sketch.delete…)
